shared_elements: large circular disc/ring as a focal element
small paired oval/rounded motifs flanking the central disc
bands or registers of repeated blocky motifs framing the field
justification: Both surfaces centre on a prominent circular disc set among smaller rounded, block-like relief motifs arranged in bands, which is the most specific correspondence. However A is a three-dimensional upright anthropomorphic boulder photographed in the round, with its disc set high on a body and the design following an irregular vertical form, whereas B is a flat rectangular field with a strictly ruled border of regular glyph cartouches enclosing the disc — utterly different formats and rendering.
